scope.model_selection: Every raw [[model]] row in the selected TOML profiles. Image-service model rows are separate service records.
scope.region: Profile region, endpoint and account product are explicit; evidence never transfers from mainland to international or from metered API to Coding Plan.
scope.unknown_policy: Unknown means reviewed evidence does not establish this exact combination. Omitted features, compatible wire formats and failed fetches are not negative proof.
scope.availability_policy: Documented is a public contract, not live entitlement. shut_down overrides callability. Unknown availability does not deny service.
scope.freshness_policy: Dated documentation snapshot. Tests are offline and do not call provider accounts.
scope.services_policy: Services require independent routes, credentials and model selection. A supported service does not establish support for a completion model. Service rows are scoped to each profile without inheriting its chat URL.
scope.evidence_inheritance: Model and service cells inherit evidence_date and live_validation from their containing record; source_ids resolve to dated first-party source records.
scope.retirement_policy: Explicitly retired catalog rows removed from active presets remain in retired_models as historical evidence, outside current coverage.

basis_definitions.not_established: Reviewed sources do not establish this exact model, endpoint or regional combination.

qwen.rag.chunks.add.section: Add Chunk endpoint: POST /api/v1/indices/rag/index/chunk/create; page documents the Beijing workspace route.

qwen.rag.chunks.list.section: List Chunks endpoint: POST /api/v1/indices/rag/index/chunklist; page documents request-body pagination for the Beijing workspace.

qwen.rag.chunks.update.section: Update Chunk endpoint: POST /api/v1/indices/rag/index/chunk/update; page documents the Beijing workspace route.

qwen.rag.chunks.delete.section: Delete Chunks endpoint: POST /api/v1/indices/rag/index/chunk/delete; up to 10 chunks per call, irreversible.

qwen.rag.data_files.list.section: List Files endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/listFile; page documents category filtering and nextToken pagination for the Beijing workspace.

qwen.rag.data_files.delete.section: Delete File endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/deleteFile; page states deletion is irreversible and can invalidate a referencing document index.

qwen.rag.data_files.tags.section: Batch Update File Tags endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/batchUpdateFileTag; supports APPEND and OVERWRITE modes.

qwen.rag.monitoring.section: Get Knowledge Base Monitoring endpoint: POST /api/v1/indices/rag/index/monitor; reports storage and QPS over a requested time range.

qwen.tts.api.section: Streaming output API reference: POST /api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation with X-DashScope-SSE: enable; intermediate audio.data contains Base64 segments, and the final chunk has empty audio.data plus audio.url. finish_reason is null while generation is in progress and stop on normal completion. The page labels its curl example Singapore and notes Beijing/Singapore API keys differ.

qwen.rag.categories.list.section: List Categories endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/listCategory; supports UNSTRUCTURED categories and nextToken pagination in the Beijing workspace.

qwen.rag.categories.create.section: Create Category endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/addCategory; categoryType is UNSTRUCTURED and parentCategoryId/connectorId are optional.

qwen.rag.categories.delete.section: Delete Category endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/deleteCategory; the irreversible operation makes files uncategorized.

qwen.rag.connectors.create.section: Create Connector endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/addConnector; only FILE connectors are documented, with platform or custom OSS storage.

qwen.rag.connectors.get.section: Get Connector endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/getConnector; lookup accepts connectorId or connectorName.

qwen.rag.data_files.import_oss.section: Import from OSS endpoint: POST /api/v1/connector/dash/addFilesFromAuthorizedOss; accepts 1–10 files and requires a service-linked role granting Model Studio OSS access.

qwen.tts.realtime.endpoint.section: Qwen-TTS-Realtime WebSocket guide: Beijing uses `wss://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/realtime?model=qwen3-tts-flash-realtime` and Singapore uses `wss://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/realtime?model=qwen3-tts-flash-realtime`; `model` is a query parameter and the regional API key is required.

qwen.tts.realtime.models.section: Realtime TTS regional model listing: China (Beijing) includes `qwen-tts-realtime`, `qwen-tts-realtime-latest`, `qwen-tts-realtime-2025-07-15`, `qwen3-tts-flash-realtime`, and `qwen3-tts-flash-realtime-2025-09-18`; Singapore lists `qwen3-tts-flash-realtime` and its 2025-09-18 snapshot.

qwen.tts.realtime.client.section: Qwen-TTS-Realtime client event reference, including session configuration and text-buffer input/commit controls.

qwen.tts.realtime.server.section: Qwen-TTS-Realtime server event reference for session and generated audio events.

qwen.asr.realtime.endpoint.section: Qwen-ASR-Realtime transcribes streaming audio over WebSocket. Beijing endpoint: `wss://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/realtime?model=<model_name>`; Singapore endpoint: `wss://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/api-ws/v1/realtime?model=<model_name>`. The model is selected by the `model` query parameter and the handshake requires `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`; the documented workspace-specific regional host is recommended.

qwen.asr.realtime.client.section: Standalone ASR WebSocket client lifecycle: `session.update`, repeated `input_audio_buffer.append`, `input_audio_buffer.commit` in Manual mode, then `session.finish`; disconnect after `session.finished`. VAD and Manual modes are documented. Input encoding supports `pcm` or `opus`, with sample rate 16,000 or 8,000 Hz.

qwen.asr.realtime.server.section: Server event contract for Qwen-ASR-Realtime: successful connection starts with `session.created`; `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.text` carries partial text and `conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed` carries final transcription; `session.finished` ends the session; server errors use the `error` event.

qwen.asr.realtime.model.section: `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime` is an audio-input, text-output model. The documented stable alias is functionally equivalent to snapshot `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime-2025-10-27`; snapshot `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime-2026-02-10` is also listed. The model page has separate China (Beijing) and Singapore sections.

qwen.asr.realtime.guide.section: The Qwen3-ASR-Flash-Realtime model list explicitly names stable alias `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime` (equivalent to `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime-2025-10-27`), snapshots `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime-2026-02-10` and `qwen3-asr-flash-realtime-2025-10-27`, under both China (Beijing) and Singapore. This standalone ASR service is separate from Qwen Omni and file transcription.

qwen.rag.knowledge_search.section: Published Knowledge Search REST API uses `POST /api/v1/indices/knowledge/search` at the Beijing workspace host `https://{workspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com`. A Knowledge Retrieval service must already be created and published; callers supply its `agent_id`. If it is unpublished, the API returns Agent-not-published. Search strategy is preconfigured in the published service; requests provide `query` and/or `images`, with optional per-Knowledge-Base `kb_search_configs` filters. This API does not create or publish the service.

qwen.rag.knowledge_chat.section: Beijing workspace Knowledge Chat endpoint is `POST /api/v2/apps/knowledge/chat` with an SSE response. A Knowledge Q&A service must first be created and published; callers pass its `agent_id`, and an unpublished service returns Agent-not-published. The platform does not persist conversation state, so callers send the full `messages` history on each request. Streaming is required (`stream: true`). The API exposes no model-selection field; optional service-level `enable_cache_control` is not evidence for generic model cache capabilities.

qwen.audio_generation.section: Qwen Audio 3.1 TTS Next: Beijing workspace SpeechSynthesizer, reference audio controls, synchronous signed URL result.

qwen.livetranslate.section: LiveTranslate3.5 alias/snapshot and3.8; separate session and text event dialects, explicit Beijing/Singapore workspace WSS, audio/video translation and session.finish lifecycle.

glm.knowledge.file_upload.section: Current Knowledge API multipart upload_document/{id}, files/options and per-file successInfos/failedInfos; distinct from deprecated Agent upload.

minimax.http_tts_stream.section: Official CLI SSE audio parser: data.audio hex, terminal data.status2 or DONE, native provider errors. No subtitle-chunk or stream_options-child schema inferred.

glm.realtime-sdk-models.section: Vendor SDK response function completion and FunctionCallOutputItem both expose call_id; function output and explicit response.create. Older guide/example omits correlation; no live acceptance claimed.

minimax.http_tts.cn.section: Regional T2A HTTP reference: stream=true, MP3 and hex constraints, word_streaming request option. Streaming subtitle payload shape not inferred.

minimax.http_tts.intl.section: Regional T2A HTTP reference: stream=true, MP3 and hex constraints, word_streaming request option. Streaming subtitle payload shape not inferred.
